hypothesis: Corrected-QfO baseline recall losses can be prioritized by candidate-family separation versus native pair omission within a candidate, with initial HMM hit presence providing context rather than causal attribution.
baseline: Independently read-back membership:control_direct in hillclimb_comparison_readback_v3_20261012; its original corrected-QfO numeric initial-search checkpoint and matching CPM 0.1 satellite_v2 candidate partition.
cohort: Every asserted VGNC reference pair; no sampling by observed success, family size, or score.
observations: Native TP/FN status, checked exactly against retained raw scorer rows.
Same or different RootHOG membership, never substituted for native pair predictions.
Presence and normalized scores of each directed significant initial HMM hit.
gates: Pin reference, participant database, raw scorer rows, original factorial manifest, comparison report, checkpoint arrays, partitions, native pairs, and helper source bytes before and after analysis.

Preserve native last-label and accession-alias conventions; resolve selected reference accessions through exact pinned database aliases into exactly one input gene per reference protein. Reject absent or ambiguous input mapping; never strip species suffixes heuristically.
Reproduce VGNC pooled precision, recall, and F1; require native truth pairs to match raw TP/FN exactly.
Verify checkpoint numeric integrity, full candidate and RootHOG gene universes, native pair order, uniqueness, and admitted count.
Test stage classification, directional hits, ambiguous mappings, malformed arrays and partitions, native-pair semantics, and evidence mutation.
selection_rule: Use the complete descriptive trace to motivate a separately prespecified mechanism-specific experiment. This diagnostic selects no default and establishes no new accuracy gain.
scope: Development-exposed post-hoc localization using cached outputs, not fresh initial-search recovery or independent confirmation.
causal_limits: Cached hit absence cannot distinguish prefilter sensitivity, candidate cap, ranking, or significance threshold rejection.
Direct hit presence does not imply native RBNH edge admission or prove a causal clustering error.
Candidate and root membership do not resolve which reconciliation, tree, or satellite rule caused an omitted pair.
